name: Reading Buddies (Teen Big Buddies)
what_you_do: Read with a child in grades 2 to 4 for one hour a week for six weeks and do fun reading activities. You are the 'Big Buddy'.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18. New volunteers send 2 references and go to a training session.
duration: 6 weekly sessions, 60 minutes each, twice a year (spring and fall)
deadline_text: Fall 2026 teen applications closed. Fall sessions run Oct 13 to Nov 25, 2026. Spring sessions are expected next.
how_to_apply: Apply on the City of Surrey My Impact page (an account is needed). Send 2 references. Attend training before the program starts.
notes: You must attend all 6 sessions. Branches: City Centre, Clayton, Cloverdale, Fleetwood, Guildford, Newton, Ocean Park, Semiahmoo, Strawberry Hill. Spring dates not posted when read.
